exposure: antibiotic prophylaxis (AP) given within 30 compared to 30-60 min before skin incision
Antibiotic prophylaxis timing (within 30 minutes vs. 30-60 minutes before skin incision)
Women who had laboring cesarean deliveries
finding: There was no significant difference in the incidence of infectious morbidity or surgical site infection between women who received antibiotic prophylaxis within 30 minutes and those who received it 30-60 minutes before skin incision during cesarean delivery.
